title: SvcCatalogFilterCriteria - Data API
description: Represents an eligibility rule that determines if a Service Catalog user has access to a catalog item. This object is available in API version 60.0 and later.

Description.description: A description that states the restriction placed on a user’s access to a catalog items eligibility.

DeveloperName.description: The unique name of the object in the API. The name: must be 40 characters or fewer must begin with a letter can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters can’t include spaces can’t end with an underscore can’t contain 2 consecutive underscores In managed packages, this field prevents naming conflicts on package installations. With this field, a developer can change the object’s name in a managed package and the changes are reflected in a subscriber’s organization.

IsActive.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsActive.description: Specifies if the eligibility rule is active. The default value is false.

Language.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
Language.description: Supported languages for eligibility rules Possible values are: da—Danish de—German en_US—English es—Spanish es_MX—Spanish (Mexico) fi—Finnish fr—French it—Italian ja—Japanese ko—Korean nl_NL—Dutch no—Norwegian pt_BR—Portuguese (Brazil) ru—Russian sv—Swedish th—Thai zh_CN—Chinese (Simplified) zh_TW—Chinese (Traditional)

ManageableState.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
ManageableState.description: Describes the manageable state of a catalog item that is contained in a package. Possible values are: beta—Managed-Beta deleted—Managed-Proposed-Deleted deprecated—Managed-Proposed-Deprecated deprecatedEditable—SecondGen-Installed-Deprecated installed—Managed-Installed installedEditable—SecondGen-Installed-Editable released—Managed-Released unmanaged—Unmanaged

MasterLabel.description: The label of the eligibility rule record.

Metadata.description: The metadata type associated with the SvcCatalogFilterCriteria object.

NumOfRelatedItems.description: The number of catalog items that has the eligibility rule.

special_access_rules: To access this object, get the Service Catalog Access permission set license.
